column3: requireScopeValidForRole (#3546) reads only immutable facts: the role's name (role names cannot be changed) and, for an environment scope, which project the environment belongs to (an environment never changes project). No concurrent write can change its verdict between the check and the AssignRoleWithExpiry write, so every interleaving equals a serial order. A concurrently deleted environment is the same outcome as a grant that committed just before the deletion.
